M.build_note: -m 2: this collection holds 17 unique sequences spread over several genera, so no cluster reaches the documented floor of 5 and the feature builds zero profiles at it. The identity floor -mi 0.8 is unchanged, so a profile still rests on sequences that are 80% identical.
M.note: ORF4, 208-264 aa, three N-terminal transmembrane segments, 21% identity over 116 aa to the white bream virus M (PMID 25205093). The subfamily holds two orthogroups of it, 28% identical to each other over 163 aa; both are bound here by homology to the protein that paper names, not by position.

N.note: ORF5a, 129-246 aa; the ball python nidovirus protein is 152 aa with a Pfam Arteri_nucleo hit and a predicted pI of 10.6 (PMID 25205093). Antisera against it detect infection in green tree pythons (PMID 28794044).

ORF1A.build_note: -m 2: this collection holds 12 unique sequences spread over several genera, so no cluster reaches the documented floor of 5 and the feature builds zero profiles at it. The identity floor -mi 0.8 is unchanged, so a profile still rests on sequences that are 80% identical.
ORF1A.note: pp1a, 3,840-6,570 aa; ball python nidovirus ORF1a is 5,803 aa and every domain in it -- protein kinase, transmembrane regions, main protease, and in ORF1b the RdRp, Zn-helicase, exoribonuclease, NendoU and O-methyltransferase -- is an HMM prediction. The describing paper says functional experiments are still needed to validate the cleavage pattern, so this module declares no mature peptide.

ORF1AB.build_note: min_len/max_len in amino acids, from the 20 transcript_edit references this build wrote: observed 5114-8927 aa, with 10% slack either side.
ORF1AB.note: Expressed by -1 ribosomal frameshifting. ORF1a and ORF1b overlap by 52 nt and the overlap carries the A-rich slippery heptamer AAAAAAC, not the UUUAAAC of the rest of this family (PMID 25205093; NC_024709 misc_feature 18405..18411, CDS join(1018..18411,18411..25343)); the signal was independently described as the astrovirus/retrovirus type (PMID 25063552). It is putative: no serpentovirus frameshift has been measured. No PSSM.

S.note: ORF2, 821-1,141 aa. The S2 fusion domain is detectable (18% identity over 333 aa to a coronavirus spike) while S1 has no detectable homology (PMID 25205093). No cleavage site is published, so no subunits are declared.

UNC1.build_note: -m 2: this collection holds 7 unique sequences spread over several genera, so no cluster reaches the documented floor of 5 and the feature builds zero profiles at it. The identity floor -mi 0.8 is unchanged, so a profile still rests on sequences that are 80% identical.
UNC1.note: the 3'-terminal accessory of Pregotovirus (499-510 aa) together with the ORF reported to resemble the paramyxovirus haemagglutinin-neuraminidase (479-506 aa, PMID 25063552). They are ONE feature by measurement: as separate features their profiles called each other's loci at identical coordinates in Xinzhou nematode virus 6 and Bellinger River virus, although blastp finds no HSP between the two collections even at e=10. The HN resemblance is a sequence similarity, not a demonstrated function. No function is published for any serpentovirus accessory ORF (PMID 25205093). One profile set per orthogroup; genome position was used only to tell one orthogroup from another.
